note: The isle demo's city page's ground and streets on the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md). Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py settlements/isle-demo after any change, then python3 build.py. ground.* are the town ground's layers (src/60-isle-draw.js DRAW.ground, a planar world-xz shader over the vertex colours): tilled (the farmland's parcels), damp (the beach below the tide line), sandrock (the upper beach, mossy rocks), shingle (the steep shore); path.* are the streets' surfaces by class (DRAW.streets): gravel (avenue, highway, main), grass (side, alley: the dry grass path).
